settings.save_dir_placeholder: Leave empty to use output/ next to the program

layer.add_title: PNG to add as a reference layer

layerbar.ref_none: Reference layers: none visible (Shift+B shows Base Body)

dlg.import.link_tip: Keep ratio: changing width updates height, and vice versa
dlg.import.scope_edge: Only areas connected to the edge (recommended)

dlg.import.result_mismatch: Result: {w} × {h} — does not match the sheet spec ({sw}×{sh}), so the grid won't line up. Turn on 'Fit to sheet size' or change the size.
dlg.import.result_free: Result: {w} × {h} — no spec. You'll set the sheet spec when opening.
dlg.import.skip_ready: Open sheets that already match a spec and have transparency without this dialog
dlg.import.fit_canvas_tip: If the result is smaller than the sheet spec, pad with transparency; if larger, crop the overflow so it matches the sheet size exactly (so the grid and Base Body line up).

status.mask_size_skip: {name} has a different size than the sheet, so the mask was not loaded.

dlg.mask_check.title: Mask Check Before Saving
dlg.convert.title: Convert Color → Gray + Mask
dlg.convert.pick_hint: Press a chip's color button, then click the original to use that color and re-split.
dlg.convert.picking: Click the original where chip {n}'s representative color is.
dlg.convert.norm_rule: Remaps to the CHR-ART.5 §3.1 brightness rule (new outfits use Unity gain 1.0). Turn it off for finished sheets (e.g. base underwear) to keep the original — Unity gain compensates.
dlg.convert.norm_auto_off: Already gray and within the brightness rule, so normalization is off (keeps the original).
dlg.convert.mode_color: Color based (default) — enter region count → auto split
dlg.convert.mode_hsplit: Horizontal split — above/below a line in each cell (single-color outfits)
dlg.convert.l_weight_tip: Lower = split by hue; higher = also by lightness. Lower it if light and dark sides of the same garment get separated.
dlg.convert.chip_pick_tip: Press, then click the original preview to change the representative color (eyedropper)
dlg.convert.despeckle: Clean specks (absorb isolated 1–2 px into neighbors)
dlg.convert.colors_note: The color preview uses the 4 colors and gain from the left panel 'Outfit Color · Mask'. Confirm exact colors in Unity.
dlg.convert.no_mask: No mask — only the gray sheet is made.
colors.paste_tip: Finds up to 4 #RRGGBB values in the clipboard and fills Primary/Secondary/Accent/Patch (a copied sheet row works)
compare.title: Compare 4 Presets
compare.note: Below each slot: darkest shade / brightest value per region (HSV V, 0–255). ⚠ when the color's V is below 0.30 or the shading range is too narrow (CHR-ART.5 §4.4). Confirm final colors in Unity.
stats.title: Mask Region Stats
stats.inconsistent_head: Cell consistency warnings — regions much smaller or absent compared with other cells:
stats.note: Orange = less than 30% of the median of cells that have that region. Ignore it if the part is simply not visible from the side/back.
panel.maskedit_hint: Pick a tool and paint on the canvas. Indexes 1-4 can't be painted where alpha is 0 (alpha protection); the eraser writes 0. Alt+click = Source, Shift/Ctrl+click = Target.

panel.pair_off: Not in pair work. Use it to build one outfit for both F and M body types in a row.

dlg.celledit.title: Cell Editor — {range}
dlg.celledit.state_pick: 💧 Eyedropper — click a pixel to take its color (and mask index)
dlg.celledit.hint: Q image↔mask editing · Left = paint · right = erase · B paint · E erase · I eyedropper · G fill · V move · H flip · M mask view · hold Alt for eyedropper · 1-5 color slots (X previous) · [ ] brush size · Shift+click straight line · wheel scrolls, Ctrl/Alt+wheel zooms. Only the area inside the thick border is edited; neighbor cells are view-only. Apply (Ctrl+Enter) is a single undo step in the main window.
validate.name_mask_suffix: File name '{name}' ends with _M — that is the mask file naming (…_M.png); don't use it for a sheet.
validate.name_case: Use upper case in file names: '{name}' → '{fixed}'
validate.name_legacy_kind: Kind letter '{kind}' is an old file name — the rule is U underwear / P common / G group·squad / N NPC / S swim·special (CHR-ART.5 §3.2).
validate.name_motion: Prefix '{prefix}' differs from the sheet spec motion '{motion}'.
validate.name_common_exists: A body-common file with the same ID ({name}) is in the folder — the game looks for the body-specific file first.
validate.name_gendered_exists: Body-specific files with the same ID ({names}) are in the folder, so this common file won't be used for those bodies.
validate.name_stale_mask: Saving without a mask, but an old mask {name} is still in the folder — delete it if it no longer matches.
status.meta_no_template: no .meta template of the same size in the folder — Unity will create default settings
status.no_next_file: This is the last file in the folder.
status.no_prev_file: This is the first file in the folder.
settings.meta_copy: Copy .meta when saving a new file into a Unity folder
settings.meta_copy_tip: If the save location is inside a Unity project's Assets and there is no .meta yet, copy the .meta of a same-size sheet in the same folder (keeps Point filter, no compression, sprite slicing). guid = md5('S_unit_' + file name). An existing .meta is never touched.
dlg.batch.title: Batch Convert Folder (color → gray + mask)
dlg.batch.note: Color-based split assigns regions automatically: the color with the most pixels is region 1 (main), then 2 (secondary), 3, 4. Double-click a result row to open it in the main window and keep fixing the mask (Ctrl+PgDn = next file in the folder). Save settings (alpha threshold, transparent RGB) come from Preferences.
dlg.batch.same_folder: Using the input folder as the output folder would overwrite the color originals. Choose a different output folder.
dlg.keys.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
dlg.keys.intro: Menu shortcuts are read live from the running menus. Cell editor shortcuts work only inside that window, so they don't clash with main shortcuts (B background cycle, E eraser, …).

dlg.celledit.slot_tip: Color slot {n} (key {n}) — click again to choose a color
keys.ce_line: Straight line from the last point

dlg.celledit.flip_tip: Flip the picture of the cell under the mouse (or the first cell) horizontally, mask included
